description:
This file defines the Response class within the Opencart
dSystem\Library namespace. The class manages HTTP response headers, output, and
compression for the OpenCart system, including methods for adding headers,
redirecting, setting compression levels, outputting content, and compressing data.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Manages HTTP response headers, output, and compression for OpenCart.

methods.name: addHeader
methods.description: Adds a custom header to the response.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Retrieves all headers set for the response.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Performs an HTTP redirect to the specified URL with a status code.

methods.name: setCompression
methods.description: Sets the compression level for output.

methods.name: setOutput
methods.description: Sets the string output to be sent in response.

methods.name: compress
methods.description: Compresses data using gzip or x-gzip based on client acceptance.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Outputs the response content, applying compression if set, and sends headers.
